title: Split Primes and the Exponent of Imaginary Quadratic Class Groups: paper, certification script and data
description: LaTeX source and PDF of the paper Split Primes and the Exponent of Imaginary Quadratic Class Groups, with the ball-arithmetic certification script, the sieve over 10^6 < |d| <= 2^40, the enumeration of reduced forms for |D| <= 10^6 and the list of the 101 discriminants of exponent at most two. The results are conditional on the zero-free half-planes Re s > 7/8 and Re s > 11/12 claimed in unrefereed OpenAI preprints.
